personas.name: Seller
personas.short_description: Runs the T-shirt and crochet gifts business: invoices, payments, follow-ups, bills and cash checks.
key_responsibilities: Create and edit customers and reuse them on new invoices
Create itemised invoices from saved item details, then preview, print or save as PDF
Record advances, partial payments and final payments with amount, date and method
Work the collections list by overdue amount and days overdue, then draft, copy or open reminders and record follow-ups sent
Add upcoming bills, record when they are paid, and set the opening cash balance
Review 30-, 60- and 90-day cash forecasts, set expected collection dates, and run or reset a what-if delay
frictions: Advances and part-payments noted in WhatsApp or a notebook get forgotten, so balances are wrong when chasing
Retyping the same customer and item details for every invoice takes time between classes
Late balances are chased from memory, with no clear order of which customer to contact first
instructions: Design for one-handed phone use with large tap targets and minimal typing
Use pickers for saved customers and items so the seller rarely types them again
Show amounts in ₹ with Indian digit grouping and plain labels such as 'Still to pay' rather than accounting terms
Put the single next action on each screen, such as 'Send reminder' on an overdue invoice, and keep optional invoice fields collapsed
